authority: National Health Authority (NHA), Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, Govt of India
benefit: Cashless health insurance coverage up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization

criteria.label: Deprivation / Vulnerable household category or BPL / Antyodaya status
criteria.plain_description: Family must belong to SECC deprivation criteria or hold a valid BPL/Antyodaya/NFSA Priority Household ration card.
criteria.remediation: Upload a Ration Card (BPL, PHH, or Antyodaya Anna Yojana) or SECC inclusion slip.

criteria.label: Annual family income threshold check
criteria.plain_description: Annual household income must be within vulnerable category threshold (under ₹2,50,000).
criteria.remediation: Provide valid Income Certificate showing annual family income under ₹2.5 Lakh.

criteria.label: Individual identity verification via Aadhaar
criteria.plain_description: Every covered household member must be authenticated via individual Aadhaar.
criteria.remediation: Upload Aadhaar card for KYC verification.

application.office_name: Empaneled Hospital (Ayushman Mitra Helpdesk) or Nearest CSC
documents_to_carry: Original Ration Card with all family members' names
Original Aadhaar Cards of all claiming family members
Active Mobile Phone for OTP verification
process_steps: Visit any empaneled public or private hospital or CSC centre
Approach the 'Ayushman Mitra' kiosk with your Ration Card and Aadhaar
Complete instant e-KYC biometric or OTP verification
Ayushman Golden Card will be generated and printed on the spot
